invariants: A successful exact-revision receipt remains mandatory.
Complete receipt identity fields and valid integer ctime remain mandatory.
Exact SHA256, resolved path, device, inode, size and mtime must still match.
fingerprint_binary retains strict ctime and all identity checks during and immediately after hashing.
Returned provenance contains the freshly measured full identity; later per-query checks continue to reject ctime changes.
Receipt bytes/schema/hash are never rewritten by verification.
The allowed ctime difference is explicit in comparison-version and ctime-difference fields.
Historical13 cases without exact executable receipt-bound evidence still require their reruns.
regression_scope: Exact snapshot and ctime-only snapshot acceptance
Missing/extra identity fields, invalid ctime and unsuccessful/wrong receipts reject
Current identity is retained for subsequent ctime-sensitive checks
Changes during hashing and final path recheck still reject
